item.text: Both approved posts are live, targeting US adults 18+ with audience expansion disabled. Each starts at $100 per day, with combined lifetime caps of $1,000. Delivery ends at midnight Pacific after July 20.
The first half-day shows $67.91 spent and 19 link clicks. The sample is too small to favor either post yet, so I’m keeping the split while more results come in.
Day one delivered 53 link clicks for $198.53. The summer-errands post is slightly cheaper per click ($3.52 versus $3.99), so I’m shifting the daily split to $120/$80 while continuing to test both.
Both posts are still delivering, with $248.16 spent and 66 link clicks reported so far. The summer-errands post retains a modest cost advantage; I’m holding the current allocation.

After two days, reported spend is $396.07 for 97 link clicks and 305,700 impressions. Spending is close to plan, and the performance gap remains small, so both posts will continue at the current split.
The midday check shows $453.32 spent and 111 link clicks. Delivery and costs remain steady; no additional adjustment is warranted yet.

Three days have produced 146 link clicks for $592.95. The summer-errands post continues to lead on cost per click ($3.92 versus $4.27). I’m keeping its larger allocation and retaining the deadline post as July 20 approaches.
Reported totals are now $674.56 and 166 link clicks. Both ads remain active, and the combined $1,000 lifetime cap is intact.

Entering the final day, the campaign has spent $789.13 and generated 194 link clicks. I’m slightly increasing today’s daily allowances to use the remaining budget, with the lifetime caps still limiting total spend to $1,000.
At noon Pacific on the final day, reported spend is $860.15 with 213 link clicks. I’ll check again this evening as the campaign approaches its budget and scheduled end.
The evening check shows $942.75 spent and 231 link clicks. The remaining spend is covered by the existing caps; the midnight Pacific end time remains in place.
The five-day flight has ended, and the campaign is paused with delivery confirmed stopped. I’m allowing another hour for reporting to catch up before pulling the recap.

The July 16–20 Pacific flight is complete and the campaign is stopped.

- Reported spend: **$992.97** of $1,000
- Impressions: **653,183**
- Link clicks: **242**
- Average cost per link click: **$4.10**

I promoted only your two approved posts and shifted budget toward the cheaper summer-errands post. Petition signatures couldn’t be measured without the pixel. Reporting may still finalize.
